Hi! My name is Sophie, and I am a junior at Harvey Mudd College majoring in engineering. As part of the Harvey Mudd general engineering curriculum, I have experience in all fields of engineering, including materials engineering, digital circuits, analog circuits, design and manufacturing, and chemical engineering. I am passionate about exploring engineering in industry and gaining real world experience solving problems quickly and practically. 

Outside of engineering, I love to play my violin, run, play soccer, and surf!
